name: io.github.skurekjakub/mcp-interactive-editor
description: An interactive editor in front of every file write. The model proposes; the human edits the proposal by hand and decides whether it lands.

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: A directory the editor may write inside. Repeat for more than one. Required.

environmentVariables.name: INTERACTIVE_EDITOR_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to run the whole flow without touching disk.
